theorem gram_matrix_det_eq_det_sq {V : Type*} [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  (f : V →ₗ[ℝ] V) (b : Basis (Fin (FiniteDimensional.finrank ℝ V)) ℝ V) (h : Orthonormal ℝ b) :
  let n := FiniteDimensional.finrank ℝ V
  let G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := fun i j => inner (f (b i)) (f (b j))
  G.det = ((LinearMap.toMatrix b b f).det) ^ 2 := sorry
